overview.name: Overview
overview.purpose: Track active habits, global points and pending retirements.

create.name: Create habit
create.purpose: Choose a measurable habit and schedule.

progress.name: Record progress
progress.location: Sheet destination from Overview or Habit review; save returns Overview

edit.name: Edit habit
edit.purpose: Change name or target with its effective period.

review.name: Habit review
review.purpose: Review results, points, target changes and badges; acknowledge misses.
review.location: Overview / Retired habits → Habit review; notification parent is Overview

retirement.name: Retire habit
retirement.purpose: Confirm retirement before the 10-second Undo window.
